name: Bethesda Witness
background: An ordinary resident who witnessed the healing at the Pool of Bethesda. Their testimony about the anomaly confirms the power of the Healer.

genericReactions.physical: I'm not sure what this has to do with what I saw.
genericReactions.testimonial: I know what I saw with my own eyes. That's my truth.
genericReactions.digital: I wouldn't know about that. I just speak to what I witnessed.
genericReactions.environmental: The water... yes, something was different that day.
genericReactions.analytical: I don't understand numbers, but I understand the power I saw.
genericReactions.prophecy: I don't know about prophecies, I just know what I saw.
